$comment: Footnote demo fixture — real cards replayed from the public field record (docs/FIELD_TEST_2026-08-08.md, docs/FIELD_TEST_2026-08-10_STREET.md, eval/golden drafts, eval/ADJUDICATION_QUEUE.md). Verdicts and corrections match those records; no invented facts, no personal content. The four-minute-mile card is FS-1 shown CORRECTLY: the displayed claim keeps the speaker's negation and the verdict is of the claim as spoken.

cards.claim: Donald Trump is the president of the United States.
cards.canonical: Donald Trump is the president of the United States

cards.claim: The president of the United States is Peter Thiel.
cards.canonical: Peter Thiel is the president of the United States
cards.correction: The president of the United States is Donald Trump.

cards.claim: Muhammad Ali is the president of Kenya.
cards.canonical: Muhammad Ali is the president of Kenya

cards.claim: GDP growth in the US in 2023 was 4%.
cards.canonical: GDP growth in the US in 2023 was 4%
cards.correction: U.S. real GDP grew about 2.9% in 2023, not 4% (BEA).

cards.claim: GDP growth in the United States in 2019 was 4%.
cards.canonical: GDP growth in the United States in 2019 was 4%
cards.correction: 2019 U.S. real GDP growth was about 2.3% (BEA).

cards.claim: Kinshasa is the capital of Pakistan.
cards.canonical: Kinshasa is the capital of Pakistan
cards.correction: Kinshasa is the capital of the Democratic Republic of the Congo; Pakistan's capital is Islamabad.

cards.claim: Gold is worth more than silver.
cards.canonical: Gold is worth more than silver.
cards.correction: Correct — gold has traded above silver per ounce for centuries.

cards.claim: Crime is up in every major American city this year.
cards.canonical: Crime is up in every major American city this year
cards.correction: Trends vary by city and offense; the U.S. violent crime rate is roughly half its early-1990s peak (FBI UCR).

cards.claim: No woman has run a mile faster than four minutes.
cards.canonical: A woman has run a mile faster than four minutes.
cards.correction: Correct as spoken — no woman has yet broken the four-minute mile.

cards.claim: AI data centers have already been built in 40 states in America.
cards.canonical: AI data centers have been built in 40 states in America
cards.correction: No authority publishes a canonical per-state count of AI data centers.
